question: Where the revolt roll falls among the countries' days.

addresses.name: RunDailyRevoltRoll
addresses.comment: 0x4C07C0 to the ret 4 at 0x4C0B41. f(CCountry*) on the stack. **This is the revolt roll**, and it has exactly one caller: 0x4DBBC2, inside CCountry's daily pass (0x4DA530, see FINDINGS-politics.md). Returns at once when country->NumberOfOwnedProvinces (+0xCF8) <= 0, when the game state's in_game (+0xDA4) is clear, or when gameState->scenario (+0xD0C) is set and the country's id is not in the list at scenario+0x78 (0x4A8630 at 0x4C0881). Then, for each node of country->province_ids (+0xD00, payload at +0x0, next at +0x8): skip a province whose area (+0x2B4) slot0() is false; set denom = 10000, or 20000 when gameState->+0xBCC[country id] is zero (0x4C0A7D) - so an AI country gets half a human's revolt chance; call GetProvinceEffectiveRevoltRisk (edi = province, esi = &temp) at 0x4C0A87 and floor the result at max(provinceValues[MINIMUM_REVOLT_RISK], 0); compute threshold = round(floorf(20000.5) * risk / 1000 / 1000.0) = round(risk/50) at 0x4C0AA8..0x4C0AF3; then two gates, Random() % denom < threshold at 0x4C0AF6 and Random() % 365 == 0 at 0x4C0B03; and only if both pass, 0x4C1110(province@ESI, "---"@EDI, 3). The 1-in-365 gate makes the whole thing rare: over a year the two gates come to threshold/denom, i.e. effective revolt risk in percentage points / 500 for a human and / 1000 for the AI. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-revolt.md. **Its place in the day** (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 120, a recording of July 1941): the country's daily pass runs whole for one country before the next, so each country's roll comes after its own spies' draws and before the next country's - 926 draws for the first country at midnight, then thirteen of the next country's spies, then its roll.
addresses.evidence: Recording wr15, tick 60807912: game-generator draws by caller in order after the hour's battles.
addresses.revises: comment - its place among the countries' days

addresses.name: CActiveMission_Construct
addresses.comment: **A fresh CActiveMission**, built in place at ESI and returned in EAX: vftable 0x15F5D74, CPersistent token 0x18D at +4, type (+8) = 0x9C5500() (the null mission's accessor, inferred), two empty CEventScopes at +0xC and +0x54 (vftable 0x15B8AEC, country and FROM `---`), start_date (+0x9C) = [0x170C2B8], owner (+0xA0) `---`/0. 0x9C7150 to the bare `ret` at 0x9C725D. Five callers; AnnexCountry builds one to reset the annexed country's mission. The name is ours. **Two game-generator draws** (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 120): each country's day at midnight begins its espionage with two draws from here - inferred to be the two CEventScopes' seeds. Which of the five callers runs in the country's day was not read.
